title: The second literal ambient projective-line contraction
statement: For the rational coefficient selected by l,c in [def-sfb-rational-tate-pullback-comparison], a separated finite-type Y over a field of positive characteristic different from l, with the Noetherian and diagonal-localization hypotheses in the Lean statement, let family be a coefficient family with a whole completed reference [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-reference] for a completed arrow delta. For one K in Loc(Dbc(Y,Lambda)), with M=q*K(1)[2], and two arrows eta,epsilon normalized by the exact unitComponent_M and counitComponent_K formulas of [def-sfb-projective-ambient-unit-counit-composites], eta followed by q*(epsilon)(1)[2] equals identity_M tensor the second diagonal integral. The integral uses support2.hom, R2.map of the diagram class, and trace2, conjugated by singleUnitIso and the right unitor, exactly as in the attached Lean statement. No pair of natural transformations or twisted adjunction is assumed, and no limit property of delta is needed. Diagram carries integration fields, but this calculation uses neither integration nor triangle identities.

proof.text: Open the unit normalization predicate and replace eta by its fixed ambient formula. Its existential witnesses are only proofs of invertibility. Pass the unchanged counit arrow and its normalization to the diagonal-free trace statement. Factor unitComponent as its section/class prefix followed by the fixed class-free tail.
Factor the section/class prefix through the explicit forward p2 projection J_K using the second diagonal insertion factorization. No trace identity is used.

Specialize the proved generic-coefficient categorical assembly assemble_second_unit to the selected coefficient, the literal object M=q*K(1)[2] and the pulled counit arrow. Feed it the insertion equation, trace equation and fixed invertibility witnesses. The assembly combines the two tensor whiskerings and cancels the component of secondDiagramPushIso with its inverse. This leaves exactly the displayed diagonal scalar, conjugated by singleUnitIso and the right unitor; the concrete coefficient and site definitions need not be unfolded.

proof_origin.note: H5: Lean assembly of the independent insertion and trace-tail identities; no integration identity used.
